title: Bear 650 Scrambler
description: Engineered for riders seeking confident performance and refined dynamics, the Royal Enfield Bear 650 Scrambler is purpose-built to crush coast-to-coast highway miles and conquer rugged backcountry tracks. At its heart lies a 650cc powertrain delivering 85 HP and 70 Nm of torque, tuned to translate its 195 kg mass into punchy mid-range acceleration. Riders are greeted by an ergonomic Upright Neutral posture paired with a balanced 790mm seat height providing confident footing and natural knee comfort, backed by a 15.5L fuel tank for extended saddle stints.
